tool.name: rea-agents
tool.use: CLI; no persistent MCP configuration; optional native instrumentation dependencies omitted

notes: Public browser navigation loads ordinary site resources; application API call definitions were inspected without manually invoking authenticated APIs.
Yoodli default headless user agent showed a compatibility prompt; a separate standard Chrome user agent context reached signin and was captured through REA.
Passive network captures are attach-limited; scenario event coverage is incomplete. Do not infer absent requests or end-to-end success.
Application semantic graph hit per-file node ceiling; no complete call-graph recovery is claimed.
Full third-party bundles and large raw REA envelopes are intentionally not redistributed; source digests and bounded identifiers support rechecking.

anchors.finding: 连续对话模式有独立准备路由；不是登录后会话已实测。
自定义题目入口按模式分流，保留原题目与来源。
准备会话独立创建；参数与用户材料关联。
时长与目标主问题数量有前端映射，不能据此确认服务端最终策略。
面试官身份和压力等级分开配置。
启动请求带种子问题、时长、语言、persona、压力等级和录制种类。
开练前读取可用策略；还会检查音频能力与设备。
业务代码调用 Live SDK 建立连接；不是仅存在 SDK 依赖。
实时麦克风音频发送格式的前端声明。
问题事件保留父题与能力标签。
Live 连接支持带恢复句柄的配置；实际恢复成功率未测。
结束请求受前端时间条件约束；不建议照搬强行拖足时间。
结果页存在录像失败时使用音频的分支。
结果页支持重新处理会话。
根据准备会话生成有推荐顺序的练习主题。
练习进度分析按准备会话关联，带刷新参数。
有把练习反馈同步给教练的前端动作；后端同步语义未验证。
录像捕获有独立实现，不等同于实时面试决策。
视频提交失败的本地重试线索；恢复效果未实测。
场景读取是独立接口调用定义。
对话对象的创建独立于场景。
后续练习准备以 coach_speech_id 关联已有记录。
评价目标有独立读取入口。
数字人单独预加载，返回 id/url；并有释放动作。
数字人与练习记录关联字段明确引用 Tavus；只证明该前端路径存在。
人物配置表单分别保存职业、公司、性格、背景与声音。
评价目标存在权重配置引用。

provider.name: REA Chrome DevTools Protocol observation provider

limitations: Artifact identity is unavailable for this observation.
Observation starts when REA attaches; prior network and console activity is unavailable.

Raw network headers, bodies, cookies, storage values, console objects, and WebSocket payloads are never retained; explicitly requested primitive console text is retained verbatim, while payload captures retain value-free shapes.
Source maps are reported only as declarative URLs and are not fetched.
URL-less scripts and console events without an allowed source URL are excluded because their origin cannot be proven.
CDP discovery omitted the target attachment state; attached is reported as unknown.
Browser host platform and architecture were not observed.

provider.name: REA Chrome DevTools Protocol observation provider

limitations: Artifact identity is unavailable for this observation.
Static bundle findings are observations or bounded inferences; REA does not execute captured JavaScript.

Bare string arguments of unbound HTTP-method-named calls are low-confidence endpoint candidates; form, translation, storage and other APIs can use the same syntax. URL-shaped findings still do not prove network execution.

Endpoint candidates are deduplicated by script, value and detector; basis retains only the first matching source coordinate. They are not a complete call-site inventory or a runtime occurrence count. completeness.status="complete" describes examination of captured source, not a call-site census.
String-built routes and endpoints, encrypted configuration, and server-side behavior may remain unknown.
Page-declared WebMCP metadata is untrusted and is never registered or invoked as an REA tool.
CommonJS and ESM binding relationships were recovered from inert syntax and resolved only within the inventoried artifact container.
Graph coverage is incomplete; unavailable facts remain explicit and must not be read as absence.
JavaScript and HTML were parsed as inert text; bundle bootstrap code was never executed.
Static imports, entrypoints, workers, endpoints, and storage relationships do not prove runtime execution.
Static paths and relationships may remain unresolved when expressions are dynamic or obfuscated.
Webpack/Rspack factories were recovered from AST literals; REA did not invoke push handlers or bundle bootstrap code.
Observation starts when REA attaches; prior network and console activity is unavailable.

Raw network headers, bodies, cookies, storage values, console objects, and WebSocket payloads are never retained; explicitly requested primitive console text is retained verbatim, while payload captures retain value-free shapes.
Source maps are reported only as declarative URLs and are not fetched.
URL-less scripts and console events without an allowed source URL are excluded because their origin cannot be proven.
CDP discovery omitted the target attachment state; attached is reported as unknown.
Only script bytes retained in this capture are exported. Sources are not refetched or executed, and a response or Debugger source does not prove execution.

Ordinary unambiguous URL paths preserve relative module layouts by origin, including case-distinct spellings. Query variants, exact path collisions, file/directory prefixes, inline sources, and unrepresentable paths are isolated. A case-distinct pair is isolated only when the destination filesystem cannot store both spellings; the record names that pair. Browser module relationships of isolated paths remain unknown.

Local JavaScript analysis does not implement browser import maps, root-relative URL resolution, remote URL loading, or browser runtime behavior. It may strip import queries and fragments; isolated variants are not canonical targets.
Source-map declarations are retained as metadata. No source maps or missing dependencies are fetched or reconstructed.

Scenario response bytes preserve the output of Playwright's Response.body() API; any source-body provenance caveat from the capture is retained in this manifest. Debugger sources are the exposed text encoded as UTF-8. Redacted bytes are exported exactly as retained, and may no longer parse as JavaScript.

provider.name: REA Playwright browser scenario capture provider

limitations: Artifact identity is unavailable for this observation.
Event sequence records provider receipt order; simultaneous browser causality is not inferred.
Network content is retained only when selected; Playwright response-body bytes are API results and are not guaranteed to match wire bytes.
Request bytes are limited to what Playwright exposes; not_exposed does not establish body absence or multipart file coverage.
Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and the observer does not request bodies from unfinished responses.
Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
Some network requests had not completed when capture ended; later activity is unknown.
Browser host platform and architecture were not observed.
